title: hard FIPS filter in lookup: non-FIPS providers invisible when FIPS active
description: src/provider/crypto2dev_registry.c crypto2dev_lookup_algo() — when fips_mode is true, the loop body immediately continues (skips) any provider with !p->is_fips, with no fallback to non-FIPS providers. This is correct: FIPS 140-3 operational requirement is that FIPS-validated crypto and non-validated crypto are not interchangeable. A 'prefer FIPS, fall back to non-FIPS' policy would allow silent downgrade if the FIPS provider doesn't handle a given algorithm. The hard filter means the only correct failure mode when FIPS is active is -ENOENT, not silent use of unvalidated code. A reviewer might suggest the fallback for usability; that fallback would void the CMVP certification for any operation that used the fallback path.
